# titans-modern-ui — llms.txt

> Titansoft internal Arabic-first UI library (Next.js + shadcn/ui, RTL-native).
> Agents: read AGENTS.md, then registry.json. Reply in Arabic for UI copy, English for code comments when helpful.

## Quick start for agents

1. Read `/AGENTS.md` (rules) and `/registry.json` (index of 20 items).
2. Fetch `/r/<name>.json` for each needed component (files + usage + prompt).
3. Copy files to identical paths; always include `src/lib/utils.ts` (cn).
4. Wrap with `<TitanProvider defaultDirection="rtl">`, `<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">`, `font-cairo`.

## Index

- Docs home: `/` · Setup: `/getting-started` · Fonts: `/fonts` · Themes: `/themes`
- Screens: `/screens` (auth, dashboard, empty) · Prompts: `/prompts`
- Components: `/components` → `/components/<slug>` per item
- Machine index: `/r/index.json` · Per item: `/r/<name>.json`

## Component slugs

button, input, textarea, label, card, badge, alert, tabs, table, avatar, separator, switch, checkbox, dialog, dropdown-menu, stats-card, auth-card, dashboard-shell, empty-state, page-header

## Hard rules

- RTL default; logical props only (start/end, ps/pe, gap). No ml/mr, text-left, space-x.
- Directional icons get `flip-rtl`. Numbers/KPIs get `tnum`.
- Fonts: cairo (default), tajawal, plex-arabic, alexandria, almarai, kufi.
- Themes: titans, oasis, sand, midnight, plum (+ light/dark via next-themes).
- shadcn contract: className via cn(), cva variants, RSC by default.

## Prompts

- use-component: build a screen from existing items.
- new-component: scaffold to this standard + registry entry.
- rtl-review: audit for ml/mr, left/right, icon mirroring, dir misuse.
- screen-builder: full auth/dashboard/table page.
- Full text: `/prompts` and `prompts/*.md`.
